images.title: A rectangle and two triangles
images.purpose: Show a trapezium cut by two heights into a rectangle and two end triangles whose areas add to 1/2 × h × (a + b).
images.composition: One trapezium, two dashed heights from the shorter side, each piece's area written inside it.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, the main figure large and centred with generous empty margins on all sides, thin dark outlines (#2B2B2B), flat fills, nothing else in the frame. A trapezium with a horizontal bottom side 9 units and a horizontal top side 5 units, height 4 units, the top side centred so each end overhang is 2 units. Two dashed #6B7280 vertical heights from the ends of the top side down to the bottom side, right angle marks at their feet. The middle rectangle (5 by 4) filled #0072B2; the two end triangles (base 2, height 4) filled #E69F00. Labels: 'a = 5' above the top side, 'b = 9' under the bottom side, 'h = 4' beside the left dashed height. Inside the left triangle '4', inside the rectangle '20', inside the right triangle '4'. Below the figure 'Total 28 square units'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
